description: Auswertung: counts and exact sums of invoices (Rechnungen), credit notes (Gutschriften), vouchers (Belege) or bank transactions (Umsätze): net/tax/gross per currency (incoming/outgoing for transactions), optionally grouped by month, quarter, status, contact (Kunde/Lieferant) or account. Prefer it over paging list tools for totals such as revenue per month (Umsatz), expenses per supplier or amounts per status. Filters: from/to, status, contactId, kind (vouchers: expense/revenue), invoiceType, checkAccountId (transactions). Templates (recurring RV/WKR) and reminders (MA) are left out unless invoiceType asks for them. Reads up to 10,000 rows; truncated says if more existed. Computed by this server from sevDesk records, not a sevDesk report.

contactId.description: Customer (invoices, credit notes) or supplier (vouchers) contact id.

from.description: First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).

groupBy.description: none, month, quarter, status, contact (customer/supplier; not for transactions) or account (transactions only).

invoiceType.description: Invoices only: invoice (RE), advance (AR), partial (TR), final (ER), cancellation (SR), reminder (MA) or recurring (WKR template); reminders and templates count only when asked for here.

maxGroups.description: Most groups to return; the rest are counted in groupsOmitted.

status.description: Invoices/credit notes: draft, open, partially_paid, paid. Vouchers: draft, open, transferred, partially_paid, paid. Transactions: created, linked, private, auto_booked, booked.

subject.description: invoices, credit_notes, vouchers or transactions (bank transactions).

to.description: Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).

name: sevdesk_records_summarize
title: Summarize sevDesk records
